title: Committed 2MB Mach-O build artifact app.bin at the repo root (added by PR head commit 0118cc0)
evidence:
$ git ls-files | grep -i "app\.bin\.*$"
app.bin
$ git log --diff-filter=A --format="%h %s" -- app.bin
0118cc0 fix: pipe hit-testing follows the rendered bezier; router right-click inspects; readable HUD font
$ git cat-file -s $(git rev-parse HEAD:app.bin)
2057480
$ head -c 16 app.bin | xxd
00000000: cffa edfe 0c00 0001 0000 0000 0200 0000  ................
# .gitignore (excerpt — no rule matches app.bin):
bin/
goldens/_reports/
detail: 2MB Mach-O arm64 build artifact committed at the PR head; .gitignore excludes bin/ but not app.bin; the PR body and README never state it is deliberate, so it bloats and platform-locks the repo.
recommended_fix: Remove app.bin from the commit, add app.bin to .gitignore (the repo documents `odin run app` as the build path), and re-push.

title: error404/08000ms.png is byte-identical to boot/01000ms.png — the drain phase has no distinct T2 pixel pin
evidence:
$ md5 goldens/boot/01000ms.png goldens/error404/08000ms.png
MD5 (goldens/boot/01000ms.png) = 86f328b6f6cc4d758c98512ac268397a
MD5 (goldens/error404/08000ms.png) = 86f328b6f6cc4d758c98512ac268397a
# demos/error404.dem:
seed 42
map demo_six_nodes
run 40000ms
capture at 8000ms, 40000ms
# demos/boot.dem:
run 5000ms
capture at 1000ms
# core/health.odin:73-75 (drain only after the grace countdown expires):
severity := bal.win_uptime_pct - recent_uptime
drain := clamp(severity / 10, 1, bal.meter_drain_per_tick_max) // E16
h.meter_pct = max(0, h.meter_pct - drain)
# data/balance.json: "grace_window_ticks": 200,
detail: At 8s the meter is still full (grace=200 ticks; drain starts only after expiry) and no pipes are drawn, so the frame equals boot's 1s frame; the drain phase (ticks 51-249) has no distinct T2 pixel pin.
recommended_fix: Capture an error404 frame between ~25s and 39s (draining meter, strain chips) so T2 pins the drain visuals; the loss path stays pinned by T1 + event windows regardless.

title: write_log is a byte-identical duplicate of write_file in harness/goldens.odin
detail: write_log (goldens.odin:267) is a byte-identical copy of write_file (:249) with the same doc comment; dead duplication introduced by this PR's harness.
recommended_fix: Delete write_log and call write_file at harness/main.odin:310; one checked-write helper suffices.
